java.finding: CommandFactoryNote's optional color slot recognizes the COLOR_REGEXP/COLORS_REGEXP grammar. Recognition is only stage one; it does not prove HColor resolution.

Inline and multiline named notes share ColorParser.exp1 and HColorSet.getColor. executeInternal creates the leaf before getColor can throw, so Java may transiently mutate the rejected diagram internally, but no successful diagram or normal SVG survives the command failure.

Whole transparent/background resolve to HColors.none and whole automatic to HColorAutomagic. Gradient endpoints use parseSimpleColor, so sentinels are invalid there. One-, three-, six-, and eight-digit hex and the ColorTrieNode names are accepted simple colors.

The frozen inventory has 154 case-insensitive names, including seven ArchiMate aliases with non-white values. A machine extraction found the Rust parser inventory has exactly the same 154 names with no missing or extra entries.
toRGB serializes RGB only, while toSvg can preserve alpha for ordinary paint.

createSvgGradient deduplicates by resolved color1/color2/policy, assigns IDs in first-paint order, maps the four policy vectors, and emits RGB stop-color strings. Ordinary eight-digit fills are serialized as RGB plus fill-opacity.
A NOTE is Opale only with exactly one non-invisible incident link to a non-note SvekNode; two ordinary links remain separate painted link groups.
The resolved entity BACK color feeds both Opale and normal note body/fold paint paths.

rust.finding: The follow-up correctly separates whole-color sentinels from simple gradient endpoints. Its 154-name validation inventory exactly matches ColorTrieNode, and invalid decoration resolution returns None before either family pushes a note.

resolve_color has the CSS names but omits business/application/motivation/strategy/technology/physical/implementation, falling back to #FFFFFF. It preserves partial alpha as #RRGGBBAA. Both component and deployment gradient registries use this resolver for stops.

All named-note body/fold painters now call component_note_fill. However, after the sole-link Opale check, ordinary connection painting can resolve only component, interface, or package endpoints; a named-note endpoint reaches the final else/continue and both links of a multi-link note disappear.
Deployment routes named-note fills through gradient_fill_or in attached and normal paths and correctly distinguishes one-link Opale from multi-link ordinary paint in the tested topology.
The shared finalizer compacts generated resources by first body reference and renumbers gradients in first-paint order; paired outputs confirm this behavior for the fresh duplicate matrices.

ast_mutation_assessment.rust_observable: All five invalid probes exit 1 in both render and --ast modes, produce zero-byte Rust SVG and AST outputs, and fail in named_note_decorations before Component or Deployment pushes a note. ast_mutation_assessment.java_internal_nuance: CommandFactoryNote.executeInternal calls reallyCreateLeaf before HColorSet.getColor. Therefore a transient Java leaf can exist inside the diagram that is immediately rejected by NoSuchColorException. The externally observable invariant is terminal rejection with no successful diagram, not mutation-free execution inside Java.

findings.summary: The parser accepts PlantUML's seven ArchiMate aliases, but both Rust paint paths resolve them to white.
evidence: ColorTrieNode maps BUSINESS to #FFFFCC, APPLICATION to #C2F0FF, MOTIVATION to #CCCCFF, STRATEGY to #F8E7C0, TECHNOLOGY to #C9FFC9, PHYSICAL to #97FF97, and IMPLEMENTATION to #FFE0E0.
PLANTUML_NAMED_COLORS accepts all seven, while sequence::resolve_color has no corresponding match arms and falls back to #FFFFFF.
Fresh flat and gradient Component/Deployment SVGs show the expected Java alias colors and #FFFFFF Rust paints.

findings.summary: Eight-digit named-note paint does not follow Java's SVG normalization, and gradient alpha changes observable stop semantics.
evidence: Java ordinary note paths emit RGB plus fill-opacity; Rust emits CSS #RRGGBBAA without fill-opacity.
Java HColorGradient creation uses HColor.toRGB for endpoints, so #11223344|AABBCCDD becomes #112233/#AABBCC. Rust emits #11223344/#AABBCCDD stops.
The same failure reproduces in Component and Deployment with different policies and endpoint values.
